get.description: Visible tickets of the period grouped by status, category or sector, with the period cutting by the opening of the ticket. A group without tickets in the period is omitted, and an empty period answers an empty list and total 0 (BR3.1, BR2.2).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period, included. Defaults to thirty days before the end (BR7.2).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period, excluded. Defaults to the current instant.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Groups the visible tickets of the period by status, category or sector.

get.description: Average handling and resolution times of the period, in seconds, with no goal and no threshold. Handling runs from the opening to the first assignment and resolution from the opening to the most recent closing; here the period cuts by the closing, not by the opening. Declared divergence from the contract block: the single `sampleSize` became `resolutionSampleSize` and `handlingSampleSize`, because the handling average excludes the tickets closed without an assignee (BR4.1 to BR4.4).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period, included. Defaults to thirty days before the end (BR7.2).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period, excluded. Defaults to the current instant.

get.description: Average and count of the ratings of the period, added to the panel by U5. The period cuts by the closing of the ticket, like the average durations, so a ticket reopened and still open leaves the average and comes back in the period of its next closing. A period without ratings answers an empty average and a count of zero, never a zero read as a score, and neither the comment nor any ticket identifier travels here (BR3.1 to BR3.3 of U5).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period, included. Defaults to thirty days before the end (BR7.2).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period, excluded. Defaults to the current instant.
